title: Woman Thinks She’s in Charge of The Traffic Stop
description:
At around 1 AM in the night, a New Jersey Officer conducted a traffic stop on a female for erratic driving. The female refused to answer any questions so the officer called for a DUI specialist. The uncooperative female attempted to resist arrest by pulling her arm away and trying to bite an officer. The female was charged with driving under the influence, Resisting Arrest, Obstructing the Administration of Law and Aggravated Assault on a Law Enforcement Officer. She was found to have one outstanding warrant issued out of West New York for $1,000.
